title: slot_bench.v1
description: A ruled bench record (alpha-engine-config-I12024), written at `slots/{slot}/bench.json` by `crucible bench` under its own run manifest. It records that a human ruling took a slot's contribution to ZERO WEIGHT and that the slot showed NO LIFT, from `effective_trading_day` on. It is a ruled record, never a cleared one: a reader that honours it still prints the failed reading it stands beside, and the record names the ruling (`ruled_by`, `ruled_at`, `ruling_ref`, `tracker`) and the evidence it was ruled on. Only the M slot can be benched in v1: M's predictions are the S slot's alpha vector, so a zero weight there has exactly one meaning (`crucible.slots.strategy.resolve_session` serves a zero alpha vector), and no other slot has a consumer for a weight.

slot.description: The benched slot. Closed to `m` in v1: see the document description.

weight.description: The slot's weight while benched. Zero, by ruling, and the only value v1 can record: a partial weight would be a sizing decision, not a bench.

disposition.description: What the ruling recorded about the slot: it showed no lift over its controls.

ruled_by.description: Who ruled. A bench nobody ruled is refused by the writer before this document is built.

ruled_at.description: UTC instant of the ruling, ISO-8601 with a `Z`.

ruling_ref.description: An https link to the ruling itself (the tracker comment that records it), so a reader can read the words that were ruled.

tracker.description: The tracked issue the ruling sits on, in the fleet reference format.

reason.description: The no-lift finding in one sentence. Printed by every reader that honours the bench (promote, the board, the gate).

evidence.description: What the ruling was made on: https links (the confirmation PR, the experiment record) and store keys (the promote run that held the pointer). At least one: a no-lift finding with no evidence is an opinion.

champion_at_bench.description: The slot's champion pointer `arm_id` when the bench was filed, read from the store by the writer. The pointer and its feed stay in force while benched: the priced universe is still that arm's, only its alpha is zero. A pointer that has since moved is refused by every reader rather than silently re-benched.

effective_trading_day.description: First NYSE session the bench applies to (4.12). Sessions before it resolve exactly as they did, so history and backfills are point-in-time.

reexam_date.description: Calendar date the ruling is due to be re-examined. Rendered on the board; the bench does not lapse on it.

filed_at_utc.description: Wall-clock UTC instant of the filing, ISO-8601. Provenance, never a key (4.12).
